notes: Adds missing schema/contract, core enforcement logic, API boundary, and unit test coverage stories.

change_log.value: Unit Test Suite for Enforcement Rules

GPTR-F-001-S69.title: Allowlist Request Schema Contract
GPTR-F-001-S69.description: Define strict Pydantic (or equivalent) schema for GPTReader requests including allowed collections, fields, operators, and limits to ensure all incoming payloads are structurally validated before enforcement.

GPTR-F-001-S70.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S70.description: Implement core validation engine that evaluates incoming requests against allowlist rules (collections, fields, operators, query depth, limits) and deterministically accepts or rejects requests.

GPTR-F-001-S71.title: Azure Function Request Interceptor
GPTR-F-001-S71.description: Integrate enforcement engine into Azure Function entrypoint to intercept all GPTReader requests, apply validation before execution, and short-circuit unauthorized queries.

GPTR-F-001-S72.title: Unit Test Suite for Enforcement Rules
GPTR-F-001-S72.description: Create comprehensive unit tests covering valid requests, rejected requests, edge cases (nested queries, invalid operators, excessive limits), and regression scenarios for allowlist enforcement.
